name: Lakhani Underpass
historical_notes: One of Karachi's worst flood-prone underpasses. Completely submerges during moderate rainfall. Multiple drowning incidents recorded 2020–2025.

name: Nazimabad No. 7 Underpass
historical_notes: Chronic flooding during monsoon. Water accumulates rapidly due to blocked drains. 2022 and 2024 monsoon caused complete closure.

name: Liaqatabad Underpass
historical_notes: Regularly floods in moderate rain. Poor drainage infrastructure. Vehicles get stuck annually.

name: Gulshan Chowrangi Area
historical_notes: Low-lying intersection floods during heavy rain. Traffic grid lock common during monsoon events.

name: Surjani Town Low-Lying Road
historical_notes: Low-elevation residential area. Rainwater accumulates quickly due to inadequate storm drains. Frequent monsoon flooding.

name: Malir Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Malir River/Nullah overflows during sustained rainfall. Settlements along banks at extreme risk. Major 2020 flooding displaced thousands.

name: Orangi Town Drain Bank
historical_notes: Orangi Nullah overflows into residential areas. Informal settlements at highest risk. Chronic monsoon flooding zone.

name: Korangi Creek Area
historical_notes: Extremely low elevation near creek. Tidal flooding combined with rainfall creates dangerous conditions. Industrial area severely impacted.

name: Hawks Bay Road Dip
historical_notes: Coastal road depression prone to waterlogging. Combined tidal and rain flooding during monsoon.

name: North Karachi Sector 11-C Low Road
historical_notes: Residential area with poor drainage. Roads submerge during moderate monsoon rainfall.

name: Shahra-e-Faisal Depression near Drigh Road
historical_notes: Major arterial road depression. Heavy traffic area that floods during monsoon causing massive gridlock.

name: Paposh Nagar Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Nullah bank overflow zone. Dense residential area at risk during sustained rainfall.

name: Baldia Town Floodplain
historical_notes: Natural floodplain with informal settlements. Extremely vulnerable to monsoon flooding.

name: SITE Area Nullah Crossing
historical_notes: Industrial zone nullah crossing. Blocked drains and industrial waste worsen flooding during monsoon.

name: Landhi Industrial Low Road
historical_notes: Industrial area with inadequate drainage. Road depression causes waterlogging during heavy rainfall.

name: Kalma Chowk Underpass
historical_notes: Major intersection underpass. Floods during intense monsoon rainfall. Pumping infrastructure installed but frequently overwhelmed.

name: Lawrence Road Dip
historical_notes: Historic road depression. Regular monsoon flooding. WASA drainage often fails during peak rainfall.

name: Jail Road Underpass
historical_notes: Underpass on major artery. Floods within 45 min of sustained heavy rainfall. Vehicle rescues common.

name: Johar Town Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Nullah bank overflow into residential areas. Low-lying housing at risk during monsoon season.

name: Model Town Link Road Low Point
historical_notes: Road depression that collects rainwater. Traffic disruption during monsoon events.

name: Gulberg III Interior Roads
historical_notes: Commercial area with older drainage. Interior roads flood during sustained heavy rainfall.

name: DHA Phase 6 Nullah Crossing
historical_notes: Nullah crosses DHA residential area. Overflow during heavy monsoon rains affects upscale housing.

name: Raiwind Road Seasonal Flood Zone
historical_notes: Agricultural periphery road. Seasonal flooding from monsoon runoff. Road becomes impassable.

name: Shahdara Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Ravi River tributary nullah. Bank overflows into Shahdara town during monsoon. Historic flooding zone.

name: Sagian Bridge Approaches
historical_notes: Bridge approach roads near Ravi floodplain. Very low threshold — floods early in monsoon season.

name: Faizabad Interchange Underpass
historical_notes: Floods within 30 min of sustained 28mm/h rainfall. Recorded flooding events in 2022 and 2025 monsoon. Key demo area for G-10 scenario.

name: IJP Road Dip near G-10 Markaz
historical_notes: Primary demo location. IJP Road depression accumulates water rapidly. Vehicles regularly stuck during 2025 monsoon.

name: G-11 Markaz Low Road
historical_notes: Low-lying commercial road in G-11 Markaz. Pedestrians trapped during 2025 monsoon flooding.

name: Murree Road Rawalpindi Dip
historical_notes: Major artery road depression. Severe waterlogging during monsoon. Multiple vehicle rescue incidents annually.

name: Saddar Rawalpindi Storm Drain Overflow
historical_notes: Old city storm drain overflow zone. Chronic flooding in commercial Saddar area during monsoon.

name: Chaklala Scheme 3 Low Road
historical_notes: Residential area road depression. Water accumulates during sustained rainfall.

name: Nullah Leh Bank Rawalpindi
historical_notes: Nullah Leh is Rawalpindi's most dangerous flood channel. Catastrophic flooding in 2001 and 2010. Settlements along banks at extreme risk.

name: Soan River Bank Islamabad
historical_notes: Soan River bank overflow zone. Low threshold due to catchment area. Flash flood risk during monsoon.

name: F-10 Markaz Road Depression
historical_notes: Commercial area road depression. Waterlogging during heavy monsoon rainfall events.

name: Blue Area Underpass
historical_notes: Central business district underpass. Higher threshold due to better drainage but still floods during extreme events.

name: I-8 Sector Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Seasonal nullah through I-8. Overflows during sustained monsoon rainfall affecting nearby sectors.

name: H-8 Islamabad Drain Overflow
historical_notes: Storm drain overflow zone in H-8. Institutional area affected during heavy rainfall.

name: Rawat Area Road Dip
historical_notes: GT Road depression near Rawat. Floods during monsoon causing traffic disruption on Islamabad-Lahore route.

name: Golra Mor Underpass
historical_notes: Western Islamabad underpass prone to flooding. Metro construction has altered drainage patterns.

name: Tarnol Low Road
historical_notes: Peripheral Islamabad road. Low-lying area prone to waterlogging during monsoon.

name: G-10/1 Main Road Depression
historical_notes: Key demo location. Road depression in G-10/1 residential sector. Cars stall during moderate rainfall events.

name: G-10/4 Seasonal Nullah
historical_notes: Seasonal nullah crossing through G-10/4. Bank overflow affects adjacent residential plots.

name: G-11/2 Low-Lying Road
historical_notes: Residential sector road that collects runoff from Margalla foothills during monsoon.

name: Faisal Avenue Road Depression
historical_notes: Main avenue road depression. Modern drainage usually handles moderate rain but overwhelmed during extreme events.

name: E-11 Sector Nullah Bank
historical_notes: Margalla Hills runoff nullah through E-11. Flash flood risk during intense rainfall.

name: Defence Road Rawalpindi Low Point
historical_notes: New development area with incomplete drainage. Floods during moderate monsoon rainfall.

name: Pir Wadhai Bus Stand Area
historical_notes: Major transport hub. Low-lying area floods during monsoon causing transport disruption.

name: Peshawar Road Underpass Rawalpindi
historical_notes: Underpass on western exit route. Floods during sustained rainfall.

name: Lyari Expressway Low Section
historical_notes: Expressway section along Lyari River. Floods when river level rises during monsoon.

name: University Road Depression Karachi
historical_notes: Road depression near University of Karachi. Waterlogging during monsoon affects commuters.

name: Canal Road Low Point Lahore
historical_notes: Canal bank road that floods when canal overflow combines with heavy rainfall.

name: GT Road near Gujar Khan
historical_notes: GT Road depression in Rawalpindi district outskirts. Monsoon flooding on national highway.
